select
distinct

'YLA21051'  as    YLJGDM  ,  --  医疗机构代码  必填  复合主键：经《医疗机构执业许可证》登记的，并按照特定编码体系填写的代码
a.patient_id||A.VISIT_ID||a.oper_id||f2.archive_key||F2.ARCHIVE_TIMES  as    WDLSH  ,  --  文档流水号  必填  复合主键：按照某一特定编码规则赋予该对象的顺序号
'山东省第二人民医院'  as    YLJGMC  ,  --  医疗机构名称  必填  就诊所在的医疗机构名称
a.patient_id as    GRBSH  ,  --  个人标识号  必填  医疗机构内部患者唯一索引码
'1' as    SFZY  ,  --  是否住院  必填  1是，2否
nvl（b.inp_no||d.his_visit_id,'1110'）    as    JZLSH  ,  --  就诊流水号  必填  按照某特定编码规则赋予就诊对象的顺序号
nvl（b.inp_no||d.his_visit_id,'1110'） as    BAH  ,  --  病案号  必填  本医疗机构为患者住院病案设置的唯一性编码。原则上，同一患者在同一医疗机构多次住院应当使用同一病案号
nvl((select med_his_users.user_name from med_his_users where a.anesthesia_doctor=med_his_users.user_id),'李慧禄')   as    WDCZZXM  ,  --  文档创作者姓名  必填  文档创作者在公安户籍管理部门正式登记注册的姓氏和名称
nvl((select med_his_users.user_id from med_his_users where a.anesthesia_doctor=med_his_users.user_id),000232) as    WDZCZGH  ,  --  文档创作者工号  必填  按照某一特定编码规则赋予该对象的代号
a.end_date_time  as    WDZCZSJ  ,  --  文档创作时间  必填  进行电子签名时的公元纪年日期和时间的完整描述YYYY-MM-DD hh24:mi:ss（无时分秒以00:00:00替代）
'YLA21051'  as    ZYJGDM  ,  --  住院机构代码  必填  患者住院所在机构的代码
'山东省第二人民医院'   as    ZYJGMC  ,  --  住院机构名称  必填  患者住院所在机构的名称
'YLA21051'  as    BGJGDM  ,  --  保管机构代码  必填  保管患者病历文书的机构代码
'山东省第二人民医院'  as    BGJGMC  ,  --  保管机构名称  必填  保管患者病历文书的机构名称
NVL(a.dept_stayed,'1234')  as    KSDM  ,  --  科室代码  必填  患者在医疗机构就诊的科室代码
nvl((select med_dept_dict.dept_name from med_dept_dict where a.dept_stayed=med_dept_dict.dept_code),'门诊一科')   as    KSMC  ,  --  科室名称  必填  患者在医疗机构就诊的科室名称
NVL(a.dept_stayed,'1234')    as    BQBM  ,  --  病区代码  必填  患者当前所在的病区名称编码
nvl((select med_dept_dict.dept_name from med_dept_dict where a.dept_stayed=med_dept_dict.dept_code),'门诊一科')   as    BQMC  ,  --  病区名称  必填  患者当前所在的病区名称
a.operating_room_no  as    BFHM  ,  --  病房号码  必填  患者当前所在的病房的号码
 '手术室' as    BFMC  ,  --  病房名称  必填  患者当前所在的病房的名称
NVL(a.bed_no,'10' ) as    BCH  ,  --  病床号  必填  患者当前所在的床位的名称
 b.name as    HZXM  ,  --  患者姓名  必填  患者本人在公安户籍管理部门正式登记注册的姓氏和名称
NVL(b.id_no,'370912345678900987')  as    SFZHM  ,  --  身份证号码  必填  患者的身份证件上的唯一法定标识符
ROUND((a.SCHEDULED_DATE_TIME-b.DATE_OF_BIRTH)/365,0)   as    NL  ,  --  年龄值  选填  患者的实足年龄，为患者出生后按照日历计算的历法年龄。年龄满1周岁的，以实足年龄的相应整数填写；
 '岁' as    NLDW  ,  --  年龄单位  选填  岁、月、天、时
case when b.date_of_birth is null then to_date('1992-01-14','yyyy-mm-dd') else  b.date_of_birth end   as    CSRQ  ,  --  出生日期  必填  患者出生当日的公元纪年日期的完整描述；格式：YYYY-MM-DD
CASE   b.sex  when '男' THEN  '1'WHEN '女'THEN  '2'  else  '9' END   as    XBDM  ,  --  性别代码  必填  患者生理性别在特定编码体系中的代码
 CASE   b.sex  when '男' THEN '男'WHEN '女'THEN  '女'  else '男' END  as    XBMC  ,  --  性别名称  必填  患者生理性别在特定编码体系中的名称
a.in_date_time  as    RYRQ  ,  --  入院日期  必填  格式：YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MM:SS（无时分秒以00:00:00替代）
NVL(e3.weight,'55')  as    TZ  ,  --  体重（KG）  必填  患者体重的测量值，计量单位为KG
'面容良好'  as    YBZKJCJG  ,  --  一般状况检查结果  必填  对患者一般状况检查结果的详细描述，包括其发育状况、营养状况、体味、步态、面容与表情、意识，检查能必填合作等等
 '-'  as    ABOXXDM  ,  --  ABO血型代码  选填  在本次住院期间进行血型检查明确，或既往病历资料能够明确的患者ABO血型类别在特定编码体系中的代码
 '-'  as    ABOXXMC  ,  --  ABO血型名称  必填  在本次住院期间进行血型检查明确，或既往病历资料能够明确的患者ABO血型类别在特定编码体系中的名称
'-'   as    RHXXDM  ,  --  RH血型代码  选填  在本次住院期间进行血型检查明确，或既往病历资料能够明确的患者RH血型类别在特定编码体系中的代码
'-'   as    RHXXMC  ,  --  RH血型名称  选填  在本次住院期间进行血型检查明确，或既往病历资料能够明确的患者RH血型类别在特定编码体系中的名称
NVL(e1.diagnosis_code,'-')   as    SQZDDM  ,  --  术前诊断代码  必填  在患者进行手术操作前下达的医学诊断按照国家临床版2.0疾病诊断编码（ICD-10）的分类编码
NVL(e1.diagnosis_desc,'-')    as    SQZDMC  ,  --  术前诊断名称  必填  在患者进行手术操作前下达的医学诊断按照国家临床版2.0疾病诊断编码（ICD-10）的分类名称(e1.diagnosis_code  as    SHZDDM  ,  --  术后诊断代码  必填  在患者进行手术操作后下达的医学诊断按照国家临床版2.0疾病诊断编码（ICD-10）的分类编码
NVL(e1.diagnosis_desc,'-')   as    SHZDMC  ,  --  术后诊断名称  必填  在患者进行手术操作后下达的医学诊断按照国家临床版2.0疾病诊断编码（ICD-10）的分类名称
NVL(e1.diagnosis_code,'-')   as    SHZDDM  ,
nvl(e1.operation_code,'00.3900'） as    SSDM  ,  --  手术代码  必填  实施手术按照国家临床版2.0手术操作编码（ICD-9-CM3）手术的编码
nvl(e1.operation,'其他计算机辅助外科手术'） as    SSMC  ,  --  手术名称  必填  实施手术按照国家临床版2.0手术操作编码（ICD-9-CM3）手术的名称
 case when a.anesthesia_method like '全麻' then '1'
when a.anesthesia_method like '椎管' then '2'
when a.anesthesia_method like '局麻' then '3'
when a.anesthesia_method like '复合' then '4'
else'9'end  as    MZFSDM  ,  --  麻醉方式代码  必填  实施手术/操作时所采用的麻醉方法名称在特定编码体系中的编码
NVL（a.anesthesia_method,'全麻' ) as    MZFSMC  ,  --  麻醉方式名称  必填  实施手术/操作时所采用的麻醉方法名称
'无'  as    MZSYZ  ,  --  麻醉适应证  必填  麻醉适应证的描述
 '意识已经清醒' as    MZHFQK  ,  --  麻醉恢复情况  必填  对麻醉恢复情况的描述
a.out_date_time  as    QXRQ  ,  --  清醒日期  必填  麻醉后清醒时间的公元几年日期时间的完整描述，精确到分
 '1' as    BCQGCGBZ  ,  --  拔除气管插管标志  选填  拔除气管插管的标识，1是，2否
 '无' as    TSQK  ,  --  特殊情况  选填  对存在特殊情况的描述
 nvl((select med_his_users.user_name from med_his_users where a.anesthesia_doctor=med_his_users.user_id),'李慧禄')  as    MZYSQM  ,  --  麻醉医生签名  必填  对患者实施麻醉的麻醉医师签署的在公安管理部门正式登记注册的姓氏和名称

from med_operation_master a
 left join  med_operation_schedule  a1 on  a.patient_id=a1.patient_id and a.visit_id=a1.visit_id and a.oper_id=a1.oper_id
  left join med_vs_his_pat d  on a.patient_id=d.med_patient_id and a.visit_id=d.med_visit_id
 left join med_pat_master_index b on a.patient_id=b.patient_id
 left join  V_DIAGNOSIS_DICT11@HISZDBM  E1 on a1.patient_id=e1.patient_id and a1.visit_id=e1.visit_id and a1.schedule_id=e1.oper_id
  left join med_anesthesia_plan e3 on a.patient_id=e3.patient_id and a.visit_id=e3.visit_id and a.oper_id=e3.oper_id

  LEFT JOIN  MED_EMR_ARCHIVE_DETIAL F2 ON  A.PATIENT_ID=F2.PATIENT_ID AND A.VISIT_ID=F2.VISIT_ID  AND A.OPER_ID=F2.ARCHIVE_KEY AND F2.ARCHIVE_TYPE='正常'
  where  a.oper_status>34 and a1.patient_id is not null and e1.patient_id is not null and a.start_date_time>to_date('2021-01-01','yyyy-mm-dd')

SELECT A.VISIT_ID,A.SCHEDULE_ID,A.OPERATING_ROOM_NO || '-' || A.SEQUENCE AS OPERATING_ROOM_NO_SEQUENCE,A.SCHEDULED_DATE_TIME,
B.NAME AS PAT_NAME,
/*(case when length(b.name) = 2 then (SUBSTR(b.name,1,1) || '*')
else (SUBSTR(b.name,1,1) || '*' || SUBSTR(b.name,-1))  end) AS PAT_NAME,*/
TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYY') - TO_CHAR(B.DATE_OF_BIRTH,'YYYY') AS PAT_AGE,A.PATIENT_ID, A.BED_NO AS BED_NO,B.SEX,A.DIAG_BEFORE_OPERATION,
A.OPERATION_NAME,NVL(D.USER_NAME,A.SURGEON) AS SURGEON_NAME,NVL(TRIM(E.USER_NAME),A.FIRST_ASSISTANT) AS FIRST_ASSISTANT_NAME,NVL(TRIM(F.USER_NAME),A.SECOND_ASSISTANT) AS SECOND_ASSISTANT_NAME,NVL(TRIM(G.USER_NAME),A.THIRD_ASSISTANT) AS THIRD_ASSISTANT_NAME, NVL(TRIM(H.USER_NAME), A.FOURTH_ASSISTANT) AS FOURTH_ASSISTANT_NAME,
NVL(TRIM(O.ANAESTHESIA_SHORTEN),A.ANESTHESIA_METHOD) AS ANESTHESIA_METHOD,I.USER_NAME AS ANESTHESIA_DOCTOR_NAME,A.OPERATING_DEPT,Y.DEPT_NAME AS OPERATING_DEPT_NAME,
J.USER_NAME AS ANESTHESIA_ASSISTANT_NAME, NVL(TRIM(X.NAME_SHORTEN),W.USER_NAME) AS SECOND_ANESTHESIA_NAME,A.OPERATING_ROOM_NO,NVL(TRIM(X.NAME_SHORTEN),W.USER_NAME) AS ANESTHESIA_ASSISTANT_NAME2,
CASE WHEN NVL(TRIM(K.USER_NAME),'-1') = '-1' THEN  NVL(TRIM(R.NAME_SHORTEN),M.USER_NAME)  ELSE CASE WHEN NVL(TRIM(M.USER_NAME),'-1') = '-1' THEN  NVL(TRIM(P.NAME_SHORTEN),K.USER_NAME) ELSE NVL(TRIM(P.NAME_SHORTEN),K.USER_NAME)|| '/' || NVL(TRIM(R.NAME_SHORTEN),M.USER_NAME) END END AS FIRST_OPERATION_NURSE_NAME,
CASE WHEN NVL(TRIM(L.USER_NAME),'-1') = '-1' THEN  NVL(TRIM(S.NAME_SHORTEN),N.USER_NAME)  ELSE CASE WHEN NVL(TRIM(N.USER_NAME),'-1') = '-1' THEN  NVL(TRIM(Q.NAME_SHORTEN),L.USER_NAME) ELSE NVL(TRIM(Q.NAME_SHORTEN),L.USER_NAME)|| '/' || NVL(TRIM(S.NAME_SHORTEN),N.USER_NAME) END END AS FIRST_SUPPLY_NURSE_NAME,
V.DEPT_NAME AS WARD_CODE_NAME,B.INP_NO,DE.DEPT_NAME AS DEPT_STAYED_NAME
, NVL(A.Isolation_Indicator,1) AS TEST,A.Notes_On_Operation,A.OPERATION_SCALE,A.Operating_Room,B.DATE_OF_BIRTH,A.SEQUENCE
FROM MED_OPERATION_SCHEDULE A LEFT OUTER JOIN MED_PAT_MASTER_INDEX B ON A.PATIENT_ID = B.PATIENT_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN MED_HIS_USERS D ON A.SURGEON = D.USER_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN MED_HIS_USERS E ON A.FIRST_ASSISTANT = E.USER_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN MED_HIS_USERS F ON A.SECOND_ASSISTANT = F.USER_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN MED_HIS_USERS G ON A.THIRD_ASSISTANT = G.USER_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN MED_HIS_USERS H ON A.FOURTH_ASSISTANT = H.USER_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN MED_HIS_USERS I ON A.ANESTHESIA_DOCTOR = I.USER_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN MED_HIS_USERS J ON A.ANESTHESIA_ASSISTANT = J.USER_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN MED_HIS_USERS K ON A.FIRST_OPERATION_NURSE = K.USER_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN MED_HIS_USERS L ON A.FIRST_SUPPLY_NURSE = L.USER_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN MED_HIS_USERS M ON A.SECOND_OPERATION_NURSE = M.USER_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN MED_HIS_USERS N ON A.SECOND_SUPPLY_NURSE = N.USER_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN MED_ANAESTHESIA_DICT O ON A.ANESTHESIA_METHOD = O.ANAESTHESIA_NAME
LEFT OUTER JOIN MED_SYSTEM_CONFIG_USER P ON K.USER_ID = P.USER_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN MED_SYSTEM_CONFIG_USER Q ON L.USER_ID = Q.USER_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN MED_SYSTEM_CONFIG_USER R ON M.USER_ID = R.USER_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN MED_SYSTEM_CONFIG_USER S ON N.USER_ID = S.USER_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN MED_DEPT_DICT T ON A.DEPT_STAYED = T.DEPT_CODE
LEFT OUTER JOIN MED_PATS_IN_HOSPITAL U ON A.PATIENT_ID = U.PATIENT_ID AND A.VISIT_ID = U.VISIT_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN MED_DEPT_DICT V ON U.WARD_CODE = V.DEPT_CODE
LEFT OUTER JOIN MED_HIS_USERS W ON A.SECOND_ANESTHESIA_ASSISTANT = W.USER_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN MED_SYSTEM_CONFIG_USER X ON W.USER_ID = X.USER_ID
LEFT OUTER JOIN MED_DEPT_DICT Y ON A.OPERATING_DEPT = Y.DEPT_CODE
LEFT OUTER JOIN MED_DEPT_DICT DE ON A.DEPT_STAYED=DE.DEPT_CODE
WHERE (A.STATE = 1 OR A.STATE = 3 OR A.STATE = 2)
ORDER BY NVL((SELECT BED_ID FROM MED_OPERATING_ROOM WHERE ROOM_NO=A.OPERATING_ROOM_NO AND DEPT_CODE=A.OPERATING_ROOM ),0),A.SEQUENCE

select
distinct
b.archive_key||b.archive_times   as    FID,   --  FID：表数据唯一标识（如：检查号）。
a.patient_id  as    PATIENTID,   --  PATIENTID：病人ID。
c.inp_no  as    FBIHID,    --  FBIHID：住院号
NVL(d.his_visit_id,A.VISIT_ID)  as    FBINCU,    --  FBINCU：住院次数。
b.mr_sub_class  as    REPORTNAME,    --  REPORTNAME：报告名称(如病案首页、长期医嘱、彩超、检验单等)
b.mr_class  as    FDESC,   --  FDESC：分类关键字编码（厂家自定义）
b.emr_file_name  as    PDFNAME,   --  PDFNAME:PDF文件名称
'E:\EMR\'|| b.archive_access||b.emr_file_name as    PDFPATH,   --  PDFPATH：PDF文件路径。
a.end_date_time  as    FCKDATE,   --  FCKDATE：报告检查时间
a.end_date_time  as    FUPDATE,   --  FUPDATE：报告的生成时间。
b.archive_date_time  as    FLOADDATE,   --  FLOADDATE：上传报告时间。
'住院'  as    FREPORTSTYLE,    --  FREPORTSTYLE：住院/门诊。
'1' as    PAGECOUNT   --  PAGECOUNT：报告页数


  from  MED_OPERATION_MASTER  a

  left join  MED_EMR_ARCHIVE_DETIAL b  ON  A.PATIENT_ID=B.PATIENT_ID AND A.VISIT_ID=B.VISIT_ID AND B.MR_CLASS='麻醉'and a.oper_id=b.archive_key
  left join  med_pat_master_index c  ON  A.PATIENT_ID=C.PATIENT_ID
  left join  med_vs_his_oper_apply_v2 d  ON A.PATIENT_ID=D.MED_PATIENT_ID AND A.VISIT_ID=D.MED_VISIT_ID and a.oper_id=d.med_schedule_id
  where b.archive_status='已归档'and b.archive_type='正常' and  a.oper_status>0

where t.oper_status = 30 and to_char(t.scheduled_date_time, 'yyyyMMdd') = to_char(sysdate, 'yyyyMMdd')
order by end_date_time

group by to_char(scheduled_date_time, 'yyyy-MM-dd'),operating_room, operating_room_no

select  t.operating_room_no, t.in_date_time, t.out_date_time, t.start_date_time, t.end_date_time, t.anes_start_time,
        t.anes_end_time, t.entered_datetime, t.req_date_time, t.oper_status,
        DECODE(t.emergency_indicator, 1 , '急诊' , '择期'  )  emergency,
        round((case when t.out_date_time is not null then t.out_date_time - t.in_date_time else 0 end)*24, 4) use_time,
        (m.name || ' ' || m.sex || ' ' || to_char(extract(year from sysdate) - extract(year from m.date_of_birth)) ||
             ' ' || nvl(dd.dept_name, ho.ward_code) ||  ho.bed_no || ' ' || nvl(su.user_name, t.surgeon)) info1,
        (nvl(a1.user_name, t.anesthesia_doctor) || '  ' || t.anesthesia_method || '  ' || t.operation_name) info2,
        t.operating_room
from med_operation_master t
left join med_pat_master_index m on t.patient_id = m.patient_id
left join med_his_users su on t.surgeon = su.user_id
left join med_his_users a1 on a1.user_id = t.anesthesia_doctor
left join med_pats_in_hospital ho on ho.patient_id = t.patient_id and ho.visit_id = t.visit_id
left join med_dept_dict dd on ho.ward_code = dd.dept_code
where t.oper_status >= 0
order by operating_room_no desc

select  ph.pacu_bed as operating_room_no, t.in_pacu_date_time, t.out_pacu_date_time, t.oper_status, e.start_time PulePipeTime,
        DECODE(t.emergency_indicator, 0 , '择期' , 1 , '急诊', 2, '加台',3,'紧急')  emergency,
        round((case when t.out_pacu_date_time is not null then t.out_pacu_date_time - t.in_pacu_date_time else 0 end)*24, 4) use_time,
        (m.inp_no || ' ' || m.name || ' ' || m.sex || ' ' || to_char(extract(year from sysdate) - extract(year from m.date_of_birth)) ||
             ' ' || nvl(dd.dept_name, ho.ward_code) ||  ho.bed_no || ' ' || nvl(su.user_name, t.surgeon)) info1,
        (nvl(a1.user_name, t.anesthesia_doctor) || '  ' || t.anesthesia_method || '  ' || t.operation_name) info2,
        (case when ph.pull_pipe = '保留' then '1' else '0' end ) HasPipe
from med_operation_master t
left join med_pat_master_index m on t.patient_id = m.patient_id
left join med_his_users su on t.surgeon = su.user_id
left join med_his_users a1 on a1.user_id = t.anesthesia_doctor
left join med_pats_in_hospital ho on ho.patient_id = t.patient_id and ho.visit_id = t.visit_id
left join med_dept_dict dd on ho.ward_code = dd.dept_code
left join med_inpacu ph on ph.patient_id = t.patient_id and ph.visit_id = t.visit_id and ph.oper_id = t.oper_id
left join med_anesthesia_event e on e.item_class = '8' and e.patient_id = t.patient_id and e.visit_id = t.visit_id and e.oper_id = t.oper_id
where t.oper_status >= 40 and ph.pacu_bed is not null

'' as  CirculatingNurse, --巡回护士

select A.PATIENT_ID,

       CASE
         WHEN A.DURATIVE_INDICATOR = 1 THEN
         1

         0
       END DURATIVE_INDICATOR,
       CASE c.item_class
         WHEN '1' THEN '事件'

         WHEN '3' THEN '输液'
         WHEN '4' THEN '输氧'
         WHEN '5' THEN '手术'

         WHEN '8' THEN '拔管'
         WHEN '9' THEN '辅助呼吸'
         WHEN '!' THEN '诱导'
         WHEN '#' THEN '抗生素'
         WHEN '$' THEN '特殊材料'
         WHEN '@' THEN '镇痛'
         WHEN '~' THEN '置管'
         WHEN 'A' THEN '控制呼吸'
         WHEN 'B' THEN '输血'
          WHEN 'C' THEN '用药'
         WHEN 'D' THEN '出量'
         WHEN 'E' THEN '护理'
         WHEN 'F' THEN '体位'
         WHEN 'G' THEN '检查'
         WHEN 'H' THEN '出血'
         WHEN 'I' THEN '尿液'
         WHEN 'K' THEN '镇痛药'
         WHEN 'L' THEN '麻醉平面'
         WHEN 'M' THEN 'EKG'


         WHEN 'N' THEN '血气分析'
         WHEN 'O' THEN 'ECG '

           END

  from MED_ANESTHESIA_EVENT A
  LEFT JOIN MED_ANESTHESIA_EVENT_OPEN C
    ON A.Item_Class = C.ITEM_CLASS
   AND A.Item_No = C.Item_No
   )

aster."BLOOD_REUSE",master."SELF_BLOOD",master."ENTERED_DATETIME",master."MEMO",master."ANESTHESIA_ID",master."XJ",master."AI",master."AT",master."JT",master."BODY_AREA",master."GAS_PIPE",master."PAT_LEAVE_SHOW",master."WHOLE_ANES",master."STOP_ANES_AREA",master."STOP_ANES_AREA_MED",master."HOLE_PIPLE_ANES",master."STOP_ANES_AREA_TECH",master."PIN_SIZE",master."PIPLE_UP",master."PIPLE_DOWN",master."IRRITATE_NERVE",master."ANES_RANGE",master."BAK_MED",master."WATCH_ANES",master."ALL_ANES_MED_LEAD1",master."ALL_ANES_MED_LEAD2",master."ALL_ANES_MED_KEEP1",master."ALL_ANES_MED_KEEP2",master."CHEST_WATER",master."ABDOMEN_WATER",master."INQUIRY_BEFORE_DATE",master."INQUIRY_AFTER_DATE",master."THIRD_OPERATION_NURSE",master."PACU_DOCTOR",master."WATER_JT1",master."WATER_JT2",master."BLOOD_XB",master."COOL_THING",master."CRY_WATHER",master."RED_BLOOD",master."BLOOD_AMOUNT",master."SCHEDULED_DATE_TIME",master."BED_NO",master."REQ_DATE_TIME",master."QIEKOU_CLASS",master."QIEKOU_NUMBER",master."MEMO1",master."OPERATION_NAME",master."MEN_ZHEN",master."ANESTHESIA_RESULT",master."SIMPLE_SICK",master."ISOLATION_NEED",master."DANBINGZHONG",master."YIBAO",master."FIRST_SHIFT_SUPPLY_NURSE",master."FIRST_SHIFT_OPERATION_NURSE",master."FIRST_SHIFT_SUPPLY_DATETIME",master."FIRST_SHIFT_OPERATION_DATETIME",master."ANES_START_TIME",master."ANES_END_TIME",master."INDUCE_START_TIME",master."INDUCE_END_TIME",master."PACU_START_TIME",master."PACU_END_TIME",master."DONE_DATE_TIME",master."CANCEL_DATE_TIME",master."ANALGESIC_PUMPS" from medsurgery.MED_OPERATION_MASTER master
  left JOIN MED_HIS_USERS B ON   master.SURGEON=B.USER_ID
  left JOIN MED_HIS_USERS anes_doctor ON   master.anesthesia_doctor=anes_doctor.USER_ID
  left JOIN MED_HIS_USERS anes_assis ON   master.anesthesia_assistant=anes_assis.USER_ID
  left JOIN MED_DEPT_DICT C ON master.operating_dept=C.DEPT_CODE
    LEFT  JOIN MED_DEPT_DICT dept ON master.DEPT_STAYED = dept.DEPT_CODE

SELECT MED_PAT_MASTER_INDEX.NAME,MED_PAT_MASTER_INDEX.INP_NO,MED_PAT_MASTER_INDEX.Date_Of_Birth,
      MED_PAT_MASTER_INDEX.SEX,
      Round((MED_OPERATION_MASTER.Scheduled_Date_Time - MED_PAT_MASTER_INDEX.DATE_OF_BIRTH)/365, 0) as AGE,
      MED_PAT_MASTER_INDEX.CHARGE_TYPE,
      MED_DEPT_DICT_1.DEPT_CODE as dept1_code,nvl(MED_DEPT_DICT_1.DEPT_NAME,MED_OPERATION_MASTER.Dept_Stayed) AS DEPT_NAME_1,
      MED_OPERATION_MASTER.DIAG_BEFORE_OPERATION,MED_OPERATION_MASTER.Oper_Status,
      MED_OPERATION_MASTER.OPERATION_SCALE,
      MED_OPERATION_MASTER.DIAG_AFTER_OPERATION,
      case MED_OPERATION_MASTER.EMERGENCY_INDICATOR when 1 then '急诊' when 0 then '择期' else '未填' end AS EMERGENCY_INDICATOR,
      MED_DEPT_DICT_2.DEPT_CODE as dept2_code,nvl(MED_DEPT_DICT_2.DEPT_NAME,MED_OPERATION_MASTER.Operating_Dept) AS DEPT_NAME_2,USERS_SURGEON.USER_ID SURGEONID,
      nvl(USERS_SURGEON.USER_NAME,MED_OPERATION_MASTER.SURGEON)  SURGEON,FIRST_ASS.USER_ID FIRST_ASSIS_ID,
      nvl(FIRST_ASS.USER_NAME, MED_OPERATION_MASTER.FIRST_ASSISTANT) FIRST_ASSISTANT,sec_ASS.USER_ID sec_assis_id,
      nvl(sec_ASS.USER_NAME, MED_OPERATION_MASTER.Second_Assistant) Second_ASSISTANT,thi_ASS.User_Id thi_assis_id,
      nvl(thi_ASS.USER_NAME, MED_OPERATION_MASTER.Third_Assistant) Third_Assistant,
      for_ASS.User_Id for_assis_id,
      nvl(for_ASS.USER_NAME, MED_OPERATION_MASTER.Fourth_Assistant) Fourth_Assistant,
      MED_OPERATION_MASTER.ANESTHESIA_METHOD,USRS_ANES_DOCTOR.USER_ID ANESTHESIA_DOCTORID,sec_ANES_DOCTOR.USER_ID SEC_ANES_DOCTORID,
      nvl(sec_ANES_DOCTOR.USER_NAME,MED_OPERATION_MASTER.second_ANESTHESIA_DOCTOR) SEC_ANES_DOCTORNAME,
      third_ANES_DOCTOR.USER_ID third_ANES_DOCTORID,nvl(third_ANES_DOCTOR.USER_NAME,MED_OPERATION_MASTER.third_ANESTHESIA_DOCTOR) third_ANES_DOCTORNAME,
      nvl(USRS_ANES_DOCTOR.USER_NAME,MED_OPERATION_MASTER.ANESTHESIA_DOCTOR) ANESTHESIA_DOCTOR,USERS_ASSISTANT.USER_ID ANESTHESIA_ASSISTANTID,
      nvl(USERS_ASSISTANT.USER_NAME,MED_OPERATION_MASTER.ANESTHESIA_ASSISTANT) ANESTHESIA_ASSISTANT,USERS_ASSISTANT2.USER_ID SECOND_ANESTHESIA_ASSISTANTID,
      nvl(USERS_ASSISTANT2.USER_NAME,MED_OPERATION_MASTER.SECOND_ANESTHESIA_ASSISTANT) SECOND_ANESTHESIA_ASSISTANT,
      thr_ANES_Assistant.USER_ID thr_ANES_AssistantID,  nvl(thr_ANES_Assistant.USER_NAME,MED_OPERATION_MASTER.third_Anesthesia_Assistant) third_Anesthesia_Assistant,
      for_ANES_Assistant.USER_ID for_ANES_AssistantID,  nvl(for_ANES_Assistant.USER_NAME,MED_OPERATION_MASTER.fourth_Anesthesia_Assistant) fourth_Anesthesia_Assistant,
      MED_OPERATION_MASTER.SCHEDULED_DATE_TIME,
      MED_OPERATION_MASTER.START_DATE_TIME, MED_OPERATION_MASTER.end_DATE_TIME,
      MED_OPERATION_MASTER.In_Date_Time,MED_OPERATION_MASTER.Operating_Room operroom,
       MED_OPERATION_MASTER.Out_Date_Time,MED_OPERATION_MASTER.ANES_END_TIME,MED_OPERATION_MASTER.Anes_Start_Time,
      MED_PAT_MASTER_INDEX.IDENTITY, MED_OPERATION_MASTER.PATIENT_ID,
      MED_OPERATION_MASTER.VISIT_ID,
      MED_OPERATION_MASTER.OPER_ID,USERS_FIRST_O.USER_ID FIRST_OPERATION_NURSEID,
      nvl(USERS_FIRST_O.USER_NAME,FIRST_OPERATION_NURSE) FIRST_OPERATION_NURSE,USERS_SECOND_O.USER_ID SECOND_OPERATION_NURSEID,
      USERS_THIRD_O.User_Id Third_Operation_NurseID,nvl(USERS_THIRD_O.User_Name,MED_OPERATION_MASTER.Third_Operation_Nurse) Third_Operation_Nurse,
      nvl(USERS_SECOND_O.USER_NAME,SECOND_OPERATION_NURSE) SECOND_OPERATION_NURSE,USERS_FIRST_S.USER_ID FIRST_SUPPLY_NURSEID,
      nvl(USERS_FIRST_S.USER_NAME,FIRST_SUPPLY_NURSE) FIRST_SUPPLY_NURSE,USERS_SECOND_S.USER_ID SECOND_SUPPLY_NURSEID,
      nvl(USERS_SECOND_S.USER_NAME,SECOND_SUPPLY_NURSE) SECOND_SUPPLY_NURSE,USERS_THIRD_S.USER_ID THIRD_SUPPLY_NURSEID,
      nvl(USERS_THIRD_S.USER_NAME,THIRD_SUPPLY_NURSE) THIRD_SUPPLY_NURSE,
      MED_OPERATION_MASTER.OPERATING_ROOM_NO,MED_OPERATION_MASTER.OPERATION_NAME,
      to_char(trunc(((MED_OPERATION_MASTER.OUT_DATE_TIME-MED_OPERATION_MASTER.IN_DATE_TIME)*1440)/60,0)) || '小时'
      || to_char(round(mod(((MED_OPERATION_MASTER.OUT_DATE_TIME-MED_OPERATION_MASTER.IN_DATE_TIME)*1440),60),0)) || '分钟' as In_out_OPTION_TIME,
      to_char(trunc(((MED_OPERATION_MASTER.End_Date_Time-MED_OPERATION_MASTER.Start_Date_Time)*1440)/60,0)) || '小时'
      || to_char(round(mod(((MED_OPERATION_MASTER.End_Date_Time-MED_OPERATION_MASTER.Start_Date_Time)*1440),60),0)) || '分钟' as real_OPTION_TIME,
         to_char(trunc(((MED_OPERATION_MASTER.ANES_END_TIME-MED_OPERATION_MASTER.Anes_Start_Time)*1440)/60,0)) || '小时'
      || to_char(round(mod(((MED_OPERATION_MASTER.ANES_END_TIME-MED_OPERATION_MASTER.Anes_Start_Time)*1440),60),0)) || '分钟' as anes_TIME,
         to_char(trunc(((MED_OPERATION_MASTER.ANES_END_TIME - MED_OPERATION_MASTER.ANES_START_TIME
      + MED_OPERATION_MASTER.START_DATE_TIME - MED_OPERATION_MASTER.END_DATE_TIME)*1440)/60,0)) || '小时'
      || to_char(round(mod(((MED_OPERATION_MASTER.ANES_END_TIME - MED_OPERATION_MASTER.ANES_START_TIME
      + MED_OPERATION_MASTER.START_DATE_TIME - MED_OPERATION_MASTER.END_DATE_TIME)*1440),60),0)) || '分钟' as wait_time,
      MED_OPERATION_MASTER.QIEKOU_CLASS,
      MED_OPERATION_MASTER.QIEKOU_NUMBER,MED_OPERATION_MASTER.OPERATION_POSITION,MED_OPERATION_MASTER.SIMPLE_SICK,
       MED_OPERATION_MASTER.Anesthesia_Result  ANESTHESIA_RESULT,null ANALGESIC_PUMPS,plan.ASA_GRADE,
      MED_OPERATION_MASTER.ISOLATION_NEED,MED_OPERATION_MASTER.Req_Date_Time,MED_OPERATION_MASTER.Bed_No,
      MED_OPERATION_MASTER.In_Pacu_Date_Time,MED_OPERATION_MASTER.Out_Pacu_Date_Time,
      to_char(trunc(((MED_OPERATION_MASTER.Out_Pacu_Date_Time-MED_OPERATION_MASTER.In_Pacu_Date_Time)*1440)/60,0)) || '小时'
      || to_char(round(mod(((MED_OPERATION_MASTER.Out_Pacu_Date_Time-MED_OPERATION_MASTER.In_Pacu_Date_Time)*1440),60),0)) || '分钟' as In_out_Pacu_TIME
      FROM MED_OPERATION_MASTER
      left join MED_ANESTHESIA_PLAN plan on plan.PATIENT_ID=MED_OPERATION_MASTER.PATIENT_ID and plan.visit_id=MED_OPERATION_MASTER.visit_id and plan.oper_id=MED_OPERATION_MASTER.oper_id
      left JOIN MED_PAT_MASTER_INDEX ON MED_PAT_MASTER_INDEX.PATIENT_ID = MED_OPERATION_MASTER.PATIENT_ID
      LEFT  JOIN MED_HIS_USERS USRS_ANES_DOCTOR ON MED_OPERATION_MASTER.ANESTHESIA_DOCTOR in ( USRS_ANES_DOCTOR.USER_ID, USRS_ANES_DOCTOR.USER_NAME)
      LEFT  JOIN MED_HIS_USERS sec_ANES_DOCTOR ON  MED_OPERATION_MASTER.second_ANESTHESIA_DOCTOR in (sec_ANES_DOCTOR.USER_ID,sec_ANES_DOCTOR.USER_NAME)
      LEFT  JOIN MED_HIS_USERS third_ANES_DOCTOR ON  MED_OPERATION_MASTER.third_ANESTHESIA_DOCTOR in (third_ANES_DOCTOR.USER_ID,third_ANES_DOCTOR.USER_NAME)
      LEFT  JOIN MED_HIS_USERS USERS_ASSISTANT ON  MED_OPERATION_MASTER.ANESTHESIA_ASSISTANT in (USERS_ASSISTANT.USER_ID, USERS_ASSISTANT.USER_NAME)
      LEFT  JOIN MED_HIS_USERS USERS_ASSISTANT2 ON  MED_OPERATION_MASTER.SECOND_ANESTHESIA_ASSISTANT in (USERS_ASSISTANT2.USER_ID,USERS_ASSISTANT2.USER_NAME)
      LEFT JOIN MED_HIS_USERS thr_ANES_Assistant ON  MED_OPERATION_MASTER.third_Anesthesia_Assistant in (thr_ANES_Assistant.USER_ID,thr_ANES_Assistant.USER_NAME)
      LEFT JOIN MED_HIS_USERS for_ANES_Assistant ON  MED_OPERATION_MASTER.fourth_Anesthesia_Assistant in (for_ANES_Assistant.USER_ID,for_ANES_Assistant.USER_NAME)
      LEFT  JOIN MED_HIS_USERS USERS_SURGEON ON MED_OPERATION_MASTER.SURGEON in (USERS_SURGEON.USER_ID,USERS_SURGEON.USER_NAME)
      LEFT  JOIN MED_HIS_USERS FIRST_ASS ON MED_OPERATION_MASTER.FIRST_ASSISTANT in (FIRST_ASS.USER_ID,FIRST_ASS.USER_NAME)
      LEFT  JOIN MED_HIS_USERS sec_ASS ON MED_OPERATION_MASTER.SECOND_ASSISTANT in (sec_ASS.USER_ID,sec_ASS.USER_NAME)
      LEFT  JOIN MED_HIS_USERS thi_ASS ON MED_OPERATION_MASTER.THIRD_ASSISTANT in (thi_ASS.USER_ID,thi_ASS.USER_NAME)
      LEFT  JOIN MED_HIS_USERS for_ASS ON MED_OPERATION_MASTER.Fourth_Assistant in (for_ASS.USER_ID,for_ASS.USER_NAME)
      LEFT  JOIN MED_HIS_USERS USERS_FIRST_S ON MED_OPERATION_MASTER.FIRST_SUPPLY_NURSE in ( USERS_FIRST_S.USER_ID,USERS_FIRST_S.USER_NAME)
      LEFT  JOIN MED_HIS_USERS USERS_SECOND_S ON MED_OPERATION_MASTER.SECOND_SUPPLY_NURSE in (USERS_SECOND_S.USER_ID,USERS_SECOND_S.USER_NAME)
      LEFT  JOIN MED_HIS_USERS USERS_THIRD_S ON MED_OPERATION_MASTER.THIRD_SUPPLY_NURSE in ( USERS_THIRD_S.USER_ID,USERS_THIRD_S.USER_NAME)
      LEFT  JOIN MED_HIS_USERS USERS_FIRST_O ON MED_OPERATION_MASTER.FIRST_OPERATION_NURSE in (USERS_FIRST_O.USER_ID,USERS_FIRST_O.USER_NAME)
      LEFT  JOIN MED_HIS_USERS USERS_SECOND_O ON MED_OPERATION_MASTER.SECOND_OPERATION_NURSE in (USERS_SECOND_O.USER_ID,USERS_SECOND_O.USER_NAME)
      LEFT  JOIN MED_HIS_USERS USERS_THIRD_O ON MED_OPERATION_MASTER.Third_Operation_Nurse in (USERS_THIRD_O.USER_NAME,USERS_THIRD_O.USER_ID)
      LEFT  JOIN MED_DEPT_DICT MED_DEPT_DICT_1 ON MED_OPERATION_MASTER.DEPT_STAYED in (MED_DEPT_DICT_1.DEPT_CODE,MED_DEPT_DICT_1.Dept_Name)
      LEFT  JOIN MED_DEPT_DICT MED_DEPT_DICT_2 ON MED_OPERATION_MASTER.Operating_Dept in (MED_DEPT_DICT_2.DEPT_CODE,MED_DEPT_DICT_2.Dept_Name)

(
select A.PATIENT_ID,
       E.INP_NO,
       A.VISIT_ID,
       --A.PATIENT_SOURCE,
       --A.BRANCH_CODE,
       A.DEP_ID,
       A.WARD_CODE,
       A.DEPT_CODE,
       A.BED_NO,
       A.ADMISSION_DATE_TIME,
       A.ADM_WARD_DATE_TIME,
       A.DIAGNOSIS,
       A.PATIENT_CONDITION,
       D.BLOOD_TYPE,
       D.BLOOD_TYPE_RH,
     D.BODY_HEIGHT,
       D.BODY_WEIGHT,
       A.NURSING_CLASS,
       A.DOCTOR_IN_CHARGE,
       A.NURSE_IN_CHARGE,
       A.OPERATING_DATE,
       A.BILLING_DATE_TIME,
       A.PREPAYMENTS,
       --A.CHARGE_TYPE,
       A.TOTAL_COSTS,
       A.TOTAL_CHARGES,
       A.GUARANTOR,
       A.GUARANTOR_ORG,
       A.GUARANTOR_PHONE_NUM,
     --  CASE
       --  WHEN A.PATIENT_SOURCE = 0 THEN
       --   '门诊'
      --   WHEN A.PATIENT_SOURCE = 1 THEN
      --    '住院'
      --   WHEN A.PATIENT_SOURCE = 2 THEN
       --   '急诊'
     --    ELSE
      --    null
    --   END PATIENT_SOURCE_CONVERT,
       B.Dept_Name WARD_NAME,
       C.DEPT_NAME
  from MED_PATS_IN_HOSPITAL A
  LEFT JOIN MED_dept_DICT B
    ON A.WARD_CODE = B.Dept_Code
  LEFT JOIN MED_DEPT_DICT C
    ON C.DEPT_CODE = A.DEPT_CODE
   LEFT JOIN MED_PAT_VISIT D ON  A.PATIENT_ID=D.PATIENT_ID AND A.VISIT_ID=D.VISIT_ID
   LEFT JOIN MED_PAT_MASTER_INDEX E ON A.PATIENT_ID=E.PATIENT_ID
   )

(
select A.PATIENT_ID,
       A.NAME,
       A.NAME_PHONETIC,
       A.SEX,
       A.DATE_OF_BIRTH,
       A.BIRTH_PLACE,
       A.CITIZENSHIP,
       A.NATION,
       A.ID_NO,
       A.IDENTITY,
      -- A.WORKPLACE,
       A.MAILING_ADDRESS,
       A.ZIP_CODE,
       A.PHONE_NUMBER_HOME,
       A.PHONE_NUMBER_BUSINESS,
       A.NEXT_OF_KIN,
       A.RELATIONSHIP,
       A.NEXT_OF_KIN_ADDR,
       A.NEXT_OF_KIN_ZIP_CODE,
       A.NEXT_OF_KIN_PHONE,
       fun_get_pat_age(A.Date_Of_Birth,sysdate)  AGE
  from MED_PAT_MASTER_INDEX A
  )

select
A.MED_PATIENT_ID AS PATIENT_ID,
A.MED_VISIT_ID AS VISIT_ID,
A.MED_SCHEDULE_ID SCHEDULE_ID,
B.ANES_START_TIME AS ANES_BEGN_DAYE,
B.ANES_END_TIME AS ANES_END_DATE
FROM MED_VS_HIS_OPER_APPLY_V2 A LEFT JOIN MED_OPERATION_MASTER B ON A.MED_PATIENT_ID=B.PATIENT_ID AND A.MED_VISIT_ID=B.VISIT_ID AND A.MED_SCHEDULE_ID=B.OPER_ID
WHERE B.OPER_STATUS>34
